newsitem.title: JAPAN: Timing, scale of financing undecided--S'tomo Trust.
newsitem.headline: Timing, scale of financing undecided--S'tomo Trust.

text.p: Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd said on Wednesday it is considering new financing, as it had in the past, but no decision had been made on the the timing or the amount.

Sumitomo Trust said in a statement that there was no truth in rumours circulating in financial markets such as that it would withdraw from overseas operations after suffering currency losses. It said the rumours were "totally groundless" and urged market participants to take the rumours calmly.
The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) suspended the bank's shares from trade on the bourse late in the morning session due to unclear information surrounding the issuance of preferred shares.
The shares had been ask-only earlier in the session on market rumours that the trust bank was considering equity financing worth some 100 billion yen, brokers said.
Sumitomo Trust said in the statement: "It is true that we are considering financing, as we have in the past, but we have not made any decision on the timing or amount."
Earlier in the week, underwriting sources told Reuters the trust bank was considering issuing euroyen convertible bonds worth some 100 billion yen in an attempt to strengthen its asset base.
But some underwriting sources said at that time that a lack of clear direction in the stock market could make the timing of the issue flexible.
